about.title: About Open Life Alliance
about.lead: Open Life Alliance is an open, voluntary, community-built initiative. We stand for everyone's right to choose a healthier way of life, at their own pace — and for respect toward everyone, whatever they choose.
about.why: In many workplaces and social circles, drinking and smoking are treated as obligations: a way to close a deal, show loyalty or fit in. Many people quietly wish it were different. We want to make it easier to say "no, thank you" — and to show that you are far from alone.
is: A shared statement of values anyone can join for free
An open-source project anyone can improve
A community that celebrates healthier choices without judgment
isNot: Not a religion, a political party or a medical service
Not a registered charity or international organization (yet)
Not a program that checks, scores or polices anyone's life
about.status: Open Life Alliance is currently an independent community project, not a registered legal entity. We will publish any change to this status openly.
about.joinFreely: Anyone may join and anyone may leave, at any time, with no questions asked.

sections.title: The short version
sections.body: We do not run a membership database. When you join, your display name, optional country, choices and member ID are saved only in your own browser (localStorage). Your card is drawn on your device. Nothing is sent to us.

sections.title: What we store, and where
sections.body: Your browser stores your membership details so you can come back to your card. You can delete them at any time with "Remove my data from this device" on your card page, or by clearing your browser's site data.

sections.title: What we do not do
sections.body: We do not ask for your real name, email, phone number or health records. We do not sell or share personal information. We do not use advertising trackers.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: Like every website, our hosting provider may keep standard technical logs (such as IP address and browser type) for security. These are not linked to your membership.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: Images you download or share are yours. Once you post them publicly, they are visible to anyone who can see your post.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If a future version adds accounts or online features, we will update this policy before launching them and ask for your consent where needed.

sections.title: Voluntary membership
sections.body: Joining is free and voluntary. It expresses support for our principles. It does not require you to have quit smoking or drinking, and it does not ask you to promise that you never will. Any future paid extras (such as special badge designs or merchandise) will be optional and will never be required to join.

sections.title: Not a certification
sections.body: Membership cards and certificates are personal expressions of commitment. They are not government, medical, religious or legal certifications, and they do not give any legal exemption at work or anywhere else.

sections.title: Self-declared member IDs
sections.body: In this version, member IDs are generated on your device and are not verified by a server. They cannot be used to prove official status.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: You are responsible for the display name and statement you put on your card. Please do not impersonate others or use offensive content.

sections.title: Name and logo
sections.body: The source code is open (MIT) and our written content is shared under CC BY 4.0. The Open Life Alliance name and logo are not licensed for use in ways that suggest you speak officially for the alliance.

sections.title: No warranty
sections.body: The website is provided as is, by volunteers, without warranty of any kind.
